components.label: Startup transformation
components.text: The loader applies selected recipe registry changes during early game startup.
Selected recipe input counts, energy requirements, water amounts, and water charges are set to zero for the current session.

components.label: Restart required
components.text: The asset change takes effect on the next game start.
